hypothesis: The dense MoE direction is positive in both source years but the current pitch group remains uncertain. A row-local convex gate based only on selector confidence can suppress noisy expert deviations while retaining confident ones.

relationship_to_prior_work.dense_moe: Uses immutable V5_DENSE_PITCHTYPE_MOE selector probabilities and expert outputs; no retraining.
relationship_to_prior_work.constant_blend: Replaces the prior constant gamma with a single analytic row reliability.
relationship_to_prior_work.selective_fine_abstention: Prior experiment hard-routed fewer than 1.2% of rows using agreement of two fine-type selectors and a hand-built correction. This gate is continuous over all R rows and applies full dense outcome experts.

reliability.candidate_formula: F stays exact parent; R = parent + effective_scale(row) * (dense_MoE - parent)
reliability.selection: maximize minimum full gain over 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller outer scale

candidate_complexity.weights: row-local nonnegative convex weights summing to one

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze outer scale and formula before 2022/2023; do not open 2024 until both development folds and honest anchors pass.
